name: What is the process of working with a general contractor?
description: Working with a general contractor involves consultation, proposal, contract, project execution, and final walkthrough.

mainEntity.name: What is the process of working with a general contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process generally starts with an initial consultation to discuss your project ideas and budget. The contractor then provides a detailed proposal and estimate. Once agreed upon, a contract is signed. The contractor will then handle permits, scheduling, material procurement, and daily oversight of the construction, keeping you updated on progress. Upon completion, a final walkthrough ensures all work meets your expectations before final payment.
